title: India Crosses 5 Lakh Aadhaar-Verified Organ Donation Pledges; Ranks 3rd Globally
summary: India Crosses 5 Lakh Aadhaar-Verified Organ Donation Pledges; Ranks 3rd Globally

items: India crossed 5 lakh Aadhaar-verified organ donation pledges; ranks **3rd globally** in organ transplants conducted annually (after US & China).

blocks.title: Exam Trap & Statutory Distinction
blocks.content: ⚠️ **Regulatory Compliance Trap:** Ensure exact compliance dates, institutional ceilings, and penalty provisions are verified during recall.
